description: Retrieves category paths in a team to understand the overall category structure. Perfect for category organization, cleanup, migration planning, or finding similar categories. Returns a paginated list of paths with post counts, sorted in lexicographic order. Supports filtering (prefix/suffix/match/exact_match) to find categories by pattern.

exactMatch.description: Filter paths matching exactly (e.g., 'dev/api' matches only 'dev/api', ignores leading/trailing slashes)

match.description: Filter paths containing specified substring anywhere (e.g., 'doc' finds 'docs', 'dev/docs', 'documentation')

prefix.description: Filter paths starting with specified string (e.g., 'dev' finds 'dev', 'dev/api', 'dev/docs')

suffix.description: Filter paths ending with specified string (e.g., 'api' finds 'dev/api', 'backend/api')

teamName.description: Team name (required). Use esa_get_teams first to see available teams.

name: esa_get_all_category_paths
title: Get category paths with pagination
